Approach to Treatment

Gentle Healing | Lasting Results

Every person has a unique health history, physical constitution, emotional experiences and way of responding to life's stresses. Our approach to classical homeopathy is centred on understanding these individual differences and tailoring care to the person, rather than looking at symptoms in isolation.

Good healthcare looks beyond the immediate complaint, it considers the person's overall quality of life.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does it take a long time to work?+

In acute cases such as fever, it can act with rapidity, whereas for chronic conditions that have lasted months or years, the duration of recovery depends on factors such as the type of complaint and the immunity of an individual.

Is it safe for infants and pregnant women?+

Correctly chosen homeopathic remedies are safe and extremely effective to address challenges during pregnancy and issues experienced by infants, offering a gentle and safe treatment option for these sensitive times.

Is consuming sugar globules safe for a diabetic patient?+

The amount of sugar in the globules of a dose is too small to cause any effect to a diabetic patient, making it completely safe for consumption.

How does homeopathy work?+

Homeopathic remedies work by supporting the body's innate healing mechanisms, raising the immunity of the person and bringing his organism into a state of balance.
